title: lemonfiber feature frontmatter
description: The machine-readable metadata block every feature doc opens with. The canonical source (D8); the human header line is regenerated from it.

maturity.description: How far the implementation has got. Orthogonal to `status`, which describes the specification: a feature can be `accepted` and unbuilt, or `draft` and half-written in code. Merging the two answers loses whichever question is asked less often.

shipped.description: The version that shipped it. Present only where `maturity` is `shipped`; the version manifests say what that version locked.

requires.description: Features this cannot meet its own acceptance criteria without — a notification channel to notify through, a surface to appear on, an error model to express a remedy in. Enforced: no version may schedule a feature before something it requires.

relates.description: Features worth reading alongside this one, which it does not need in order to be built. Not enforced — conflating these two is what let features be scheduled before the things they need.
